Maintenance release fixing repeated usage-limit and low-credit notifications.

## Highlights

- Preserved the last available meter reading through missing or unavailable data, preventing repeated low-limit and low-credit alerts when data returns.
- Kept balance-change and reset notifications comparing against the last available reading after an interrupted refresh.
- Prevented overlapping notification evaluations from sending duplicate alerts or overwriting newer readings.
- Ignored small reset-time corrections and temporarily missing reset timestamps when checking for a new usage window.
